At a certain point, analyzing and comparing every possible rumor turns into a meaningless exercise in speculation. I understand cases where doing so is practical because of a deadline to apply or PC before a new AF goes into effect (like with the CSR), but what is the point of a clickbait post like this? Are you running so low on content that you now have to report every iota of hearsay like every other cc blog?

Verdict: not sparking joy at all

The current Citi Prestige priority pass includes restaurants and a decent guest access policy and I honestly find that more useful than the C1/Chase/Amex lounges (I currently hold both a VX and Amex Plat as well as Citi Prestige). If one of those was at my local airport I might think differently. A lot depends on your travel patterns. And of course the rumor is Citi is killing the best bits of their PP access with this refresh so yeah then they will be uncompetitive for sure.

It’s hard to imagine that Citi has taken the time it has only to release an also-ran card. We know what Chase has done. In response, Amex has intimated big things to come. With this release, Citi will either be running with the big dogs or it won’t. It really is as simple as that.

Nothing beats Cap1 venture x PP, which allows additional free memberships for each AU. I’ve got 4 seperate PP memberships just being the main card holder. Unfortunately, that’s going away next year :'(

A big question for me is how easy will it be to be approved for the card. If the card is halfway decent, but you are overly picky about who you approve, you will not get much word of mouth promotion. In recent years Citi has been getting tougher and more unpredictable with approvals, at least for their decent cards (AA Platinum, Citi Premier, etc).
